body: I would keep the same generic markup for both cases (ie. adding a `` when no such page ), but would disable them using CSS. I think the `pointer-events:none` will disable the click on the element while `cursor: not-allowed` will visually show that this will not work (see a [bootstrap example](https://bootstrap.algolia.com/components/#disabled-and-active-states). But agreed that we should let the user choose its favored behavior in the widget configuration. We could even provide several values, like `hide` or `showDisabled`. The display behavior would simply be changed with a switch of a css class on the widget.
